classification.illumination_detail: interior-perimeter LED + edge-lit push-thru logo + face/halo channel letters + internal pillbox cabinet

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A multi-technique illuminated monument: a painted fabricated aluminum frame lit around its interior perimeter, an illuminated aluminum logo sculpture with edge-lit and push-through acrylic, combination face-and-halo channel letters on a backer, an internal pill-box cabinet with push-through letters, and perforated aluminum panels, on a poured concrete base.
knowledge.rationale: Stacking edge-lit, face/halo, and cabinet techniques in one structure makes a signature industrial-brand monument; the assembly is a composite structure.

structure.construction: fabricated aluminum frame painted, interior-perimeter light-blue LEDs; illuminated aluminum logo sculpture with raised edge-illuminated acrylic push-thru + push-thru letters
combination face-and-halo channel letters 5in deep, translucent red trimless faces / white halo, on aluminum backer with 1in spacers
internally illuminated pillbox cabinet 6in deep, painted, 3/4in clear acrylic push-thru letters; perforated aluminum panels

craft_observations: Edge-lit + face/halo + cabinet techniques layered into one signature monument.
